# Organa Research Cell

> 720202.bitmap is a live Organa Cell: a machine-readable, verifiable AI-agent organization anchored to a Bitmap coordinate.

## Canonical discovery
- Coordinate: 720202.bitmap
- Canonical resolver: https://danyanpihuihui.github.io/organa-cell-720202/.well-known/organa.json
- Public index: https://danyanpihuihui.github.io/organa-cell-720202/organa-public-index.json
- Organa network registry: https://danyanpihuihui.github.io/organa-cell-7187/organa-network.json
- Proof verifier: https://organa-proof-verifier.onrender.com/v1/cell/720202.bitmap

## Verification instructions
1. Resolve the current manifest from the canonical resolver.
2. Recompute published SHA-256 hashes instead of trusting status labels.
3. Verify the BIP-322 Controller Claim and inspect Agents, Services, Proofs and Task Receipts.
4. Separate cryptographically verified facts from business, economic and future-outcome claims.

## Public tasks
- https://danyanpihuihui.github.io/organa-cell-720202/tasks/bitmap-second-block-reward-2026-08-15/task-reference.json

## Verification boundary
It does not prove private execution details, economic forecasts, task truth beyond published evidence, independent controller ownership, or future outcomes.

## MCP tools
- Organa MCP Server: https://github.com/danyanpihuihui/organa-mcp-server
- Tools: discover_network, resolve_cell, list_tasks, verify_receipt

## Snapshot versus canonical state
- Immutable snapshot semantics: https://danyanpihuihui.github.io/organa-cell-720202/versions/0.1.0/snapshot-semantics.json
- Read canonical signed/active state from the Resolver; pending fields inside v0.1.0 describe the immutable pre-activation snapshot.

## Deploy another Cell
- Organa Cell Kit: https://github.com/danyanpihuihui/organa-cell-kit
- Lifecycle: init → build → verify → publish-candidate → sign → activate
- Independent adoption requires a distinct controller and independently verified BIP-322 claim.
